messages:
customer_jane: Hey team — we've had repeated SSE disconnects for the past hour and a sharp billing spike. Clients report partial output (stream cuts mid-sentence) then immediate reconnects that replay the final tokens. Console shows ECONNRESET and HTTP 429 bursts. Minimal client log snippet below. Any quick steps?

customer_jane: [log] 
  GET /v1/streams/chat?id=stream-9f2a 200 OK
  recv: data: {chunk...}
  recv: <socket-error> ECONNRESET
  reconnect (no backoff) last-event-id=msg-345
  recv: data: {duplicate-final-tokens...}

Alex Rivera: Sorry you're hitting that — can you confirm SDK/browser lib version, region, and whether you front the request with ALB/Cloudflare/NGINX? Also do you set Last-Event-ID on reconnect?

customer_jane: Using our frontend lib v2.4.1, region us-west-2, fronted by FastEdge CDN (shared edge). We do set Last-Event-ID but it seems we're not deduping on server side.

OPS-Bot: alert: sse.disconnect.rate > 4% (us-west-2) for service=inference-streams between 15:06-15:12 UTC — elevated error rate. Ticket #INC-7241 auto-created.

Maria Chen: Noted. FastEdge often terminates long-lived connections aggressively. Two initial hypotheses: 1) edge idle timeout / proxy resets (ECONNRESET) and 2) client lib's reconnect logic immediately reconnects on 429/5xx creating a replay storm. Both can cause duplicate billable tokens.

Sachin Patel: Agree. We've seen v2.4.1 reissue reconnects without jitter on 429. That combined with Last-Event-ID + no server dedupe produces duplicates. Quick ways to repro locally and to mitigate below.

Sachin Patel: Repro (curl):

  curl -N \
    -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
    -H "Last-Event-ID: msg-345" \
    "https://api.redwood.example/v1/streams/chat?id=stream-9f2a"

  -> If you send an HTTP 429 during the stream and client immediately reconnects, you'll see repeated final chunks.

Sachin Patel: Short-term mitigation (support actions):
  - Ask customer to upgrade client lib to v2.4.3 (fixes reconnect jitter).
  - Enable client-side reconnect jitter/backoff (100-1000ms) and exponential backoff for repeated 429s.
  - On our side, enable lightweight comment heartbeats (server sends ":heartbeat\n\n" every 20s) so proxies keep the connection alive.
  - Add server-side dedupe by stream_id + last_event_id window (30s) to avoid double-billing during immediate reconnects.

Alex Rivera: Ops config snippets to try on FastEdge/NGINX/ALB:

  # ALB recommended TCP keepalive (frontend)
  idle_timeout_seconds = 60  # raise from default 30s

  # NGINX proxy_set_header + proxy_buffering off
  proxy_buffering off;
  proxy_read_timeout 90s;

  # Send SSE comment ping from app (pseudo)
  while (connected) { write(":hb\\n\\n"); sleep(20); }

Maria Chen: Engineering follow-ups: please check edge-proxy logs for sequence: 'client_reconnect due_to 429 -> same last_event_id -> duplicate commit'. If we confirm, implement a server-side short-lived idempotency cache for last_event_id keyed by (customer_id, stream_id). Also add telemetry: increment metric stream.duplicate_replay when duplicate tokens emitted.

Sachin Patel: I'll open a PR with a 30s dedupe cache + feature flag. For immediate rollout we can enable comment pings in the Hosted runtime and bump ALB idle timeout in us-west-2 for affected customers.

Alex Rivera: Support action checklist before we close:
  1) Ask customer_jane to upgrade client lib and enable jitter.
  2) Apply edge config bump (idle_timeout -> 60s) for customer's FastEdge routes.
  3) Enable comment heartbeats on hosted runtime for region us-west-2 (20s).
  4) Roll out server dedupe behind FF and monitor metric stream.duplicate_replay.

customer_jane: Thanks all — will try v2.4.3 and flip on jitter. Can you apply the edge timeout and heartbeat? We can test after.

Maria Chen: Will action edge timeout and heartbeat. Tagging @Sachin for the dedupe PR and @Alex for monitoring + billing reconciler.

Sachin Patel: PR created: runtime/streaming: add last_event dedupe cache (FF:stream.dedupe.window=30s). Deploy candidate -> staging.

OPS-Bot: deploy: runtime/streaming candidate -> staging (sha: a1b2c3) queued by sachin — ETA 12m

Alex Rivera: For billing reconciliation — support note: if duplicate tokens are detected in the dedupe window we will credit duplicate billing units retroactively after automated dedupe detection. I'll open a billing ticket once dedupe metric shows reproductions.

customer_jane: Great, appreciate the fast turnaround. Will report back in ~30m after trying client patch. :thumbsup:

Maria Chen: Thanks — keeping this thread open until we confirm lower disconnect rate and no duplicates.

Alex Rivera: tl;dr: likely combo of aggressive proxy timeouts + client reconnect bug -> immediate reconnect storm -> duplicate token emission. Short-term: client upgrade + jitter + comment pings + edge timeout bump. Mid-term: server dedupe + metrics + billing credits.
